WITH filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3,
    t.type,
    t.amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06'
),
regional_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    A3,
    AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
             WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
         END) AS avg_signed,
    COUNT(*) AS trans_count
  FROM filtered_trans
  GROUP BY A3
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS overall_avg
  FROM regional_stats
)
SELECT 
  r.A3,
  r.avg_signed,
  r.trans_count,
  r.avg_signed / o.overall_avg AS ratio
FROM regional_stats r
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The DATE columns are stored in or represent a format compatible with ISO 8601 text comparison (YYYY-MM-DD), despite schema documentation describing YYMMDD format
Transactions with type other than 'PRIJEM' or 'VYDAJ' contribute NULL to the signed-amount average (excluded via AVG's null-handling) but are still counted in trans_count
